newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral buys partnership stake.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral buys partnership stake.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said Tuesday it acquired the limited partner interest in SMC Development LP for $3 million.

The company said it acquired the interest from an affiliate of Torch Energy Finance Co, the sole limited partner in the partnership. Upon the acquisition of the limited partner's interest, the partnership was dissolved.

Southern Mineral said the purchase resulted in its obtaining a direct working interest in 16 oil and natural gas wells with proved reserves estimated to be 4.2 billion cubic feet of gas and 149,000 barrels of liquids.
It said three of the 16 wells were drilled in 1996 and are expected to commence production this month.

Southern Minerals said "This acquisition should result in a 20 percent increase in the company's daily oil production, and a 36 percent increase in the company's daily gas production during the fourth quarter."
